mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP signals a weakening economy, reducing consumer and business spending, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 70% of periods following a 3-month GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 1% within two months signals a weakening labor market, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decline in housing starts and a rise in retail sales suggests a shift in consumer spending from durable goods to services, which may indicate a rotation in the market sectors driving S&P 500 returns, leading to positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines and RSAFS increases concurrently
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 70% of triggered instances.

failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 70% of periods following a 3-month CPI increase.
